boundary: Conceptual project-specific motion over generated illustrations; not software execution footage or live telemetry.

projects.name: ai-dashboard
projects.motion_motif: Four conceptual beats: tickets and agents; inference activity; spend and machine health; evidence and human inspection. Use several parallel card streams and distinct signal pulses, never live-looking numerical telemetry.

projects.name: cofoundry
projects.motion_motif: Job cards approach a supervisor station while readiness lights scan; a control record waits for a person rather than implying autonomous approval.

projects.name: panther-intent-capture

projects.name: panther-companion

projects.name: muse-connector-tools

projects.name: el-hidratador

projects.name: taskrivet

projects.name: osprey
projects.motion_motif: Chosen strips move through a redaction bar sweep, then assemble into a proposal waiting beside an approval control.

projects.name: fluxrecord

projects.name: el-verificador

projects.name: counterfactory

projects.name: agent-recovery-bench

projects.name: reality-boundary-standard

projects.name: the-chronicler
projects.motion_motif: Repeated failure marks group together, a lesson draft forms, and a review marker precedes a reusable rule/document page. No automatic truth or live integration claim.

projects.name: mockmill

projects.name: storyfoundry-public-fixture

projects.name: vs-platform-synthetic-fleet

projects.name: the-surveyor
projects.motion_motif: A survey beam scans one machine stack; old and current map cards slide together and a changed connection is highlighted.

projects.name: the-tower
projects.motion_motif: A task card approaches the resource board; abstract thermals, memory and power indicators move without fake readings, and an advisory recommendation waits for a person.

projects.name: horizon-broker
projects.motion_motif: Several job parcels advance independently through a queue; one returns as a result and one stops on a recovery shelf, making failure distinct from success.

projects.name: bumperfort
projects.motion_motif: Vector tokens bounce through the educational physics chamber; a moving dot traces a reproducible-looking curve without presenting new benchmark claims.

projects.name: lineasflow

projects.name: VortexMesh
projects.motion_motif: Event envelopes visit separate routing, retained-log and reconciliation illustrations; show a broken-link holding shelf and dashed conceptual joins, since no end-to-end daemon exists.

projects.name: edgerecord

projects.name: edgerecord-core
projects.motion_motif: State cards retain their visible sequence as a verification sweep produces a result sheet; do not invent internal formats or cryptographic claims.

projects.name: edgerecord-era
projects.motion_motif: Evidence slips advance into ordered ledger pages, then a human inspection marker follows the retained sequence.

projects.name: edgerecord-ai

projects.name: edgerecord-com

projects.name: edgerecord-publisher
projects.motion_motif: A reviewed receipt unfolds into an article preview; a publication control remains a separate human decision. No real send or live publishing action is depicted.

projects.name: hamanakam1

projects.name: blessed-edge-deployment
